tool.name: Resize image

param.name: width
param.label: Target width (in pixels). If not provided, computed from scale or original size.
param.help: Target width (in pixels). If not provided, computed from scale or original size.

param.name: height
param.label: Target height (in pixels). If not provided, computed from scale or original size.
param.help: Target height (in pixels). If not provided, computed from scale or original size.

param.name: depth
param.label: Target depth (in pixels, for 3D images). If not provided, computed from scale or original size.
param.help: Target depth (in pixels, for 3D images). If not provided, computed from scale or original size.

param.name: scale
param.label: Scaling factor. Ignored if width/height/depth are all specified.
param.help: Scaling factor. Ignored if width/height/depth are all specified.

param.name: interpolation
param.label: Interpolation method: nearest, linear, bspline, lanczos, or label
param.help: Interpolation method: nearest, linear, bspline, lanczos, or label

tool.help: Resize an image either to given dimensions or by a scale factor.
